requirements.text: The system shall support an administrator level.
The system shall support a project manager level.
The system shall support an analyst level.
The system shall support a guest level.
The system shall allow all users to have different access levels to the projects.
The system shall allow secure storage of passwords in the database.
The system shall allow users to securely log onto the system.
The system shall allow analysts to add a new goal.
The system shall provide templates for goals, scenarios, P3P statments, EPAL rules and access control policies.
The system shall allow analysts to classify goals.
The system shall allow multiple subject classifications for each goal.
The system shall provide the ability to dynamically add a new classification type of goals to the tool.
The system shall allow the analysts to request a new classification type of goals and also allow the project manager to create that classification type.
The system shall provide the ability to update an existing goal.
The system shall provide the ability to delete a goal.
The system shall provide the ability to automatically propagate associated policy information upon deletion or replacement of a goal.
The system shall maintain traceability links between a goal and the policy from which the goal was derived.
The system shall provide the ability to display the number of occurrences of a goal in a policy, in multiple policies and within a domain.
The system shall provide the ability to display the number of different goals that occur in a policy.
The system shall display the context of a goal.
The system shall allow analysts to create and update goal keyword definitions and allow guests to view keyword definitions.
The system shall provide the ability to lock and unlock the keyword definition by either the project manager or the first person who created the definition in the repository.
The system shall allow analysts and guests to search goals according to analyst chosen attributes.
The system shall allow analysts to view elements of a goal returned by a query.
The system shall provide a template to express goals in BNF grammar.
The system shall support conflict identification and resolution.
The system shall allow analysts to view scenarios associated with individual scenarios.
The system shall provide a P3P dedicated section in the tool.
The system shall provide an EPAL dedicated section in the tool.
The system shall allow project managers to add analysis documents and assign a domain to each document.
The system shall allow project managers to edit the domain for the documents.
The system shall allow project managers to delete the domain for the documents.
The system shall allow project managers to create document types.
The system shall provide the ability to display document names and links to the actual document text within a specific domain in an alphabetical order.
The system shall allow project managers to create a new domain and assign existing documents to this domain.
The system shall support automatic multi-user analysis results comparison upon the project manager’s request.
The system shall provide a way calculate the Flesch Readability for textual documents.
The system shall provide the ability to add a scenario to the system.
The system shall allow analysts to edit/modify a scenario within a project
The system shall provide the ability to delete a scenario from a project without deleting it from the system
The system shall allow analysts to reuse other scenarios.
The system shall allow analysts to view goals associated with individual scenarios.
The system shall allow analysts to view the elements of any scenario in the project.
The system shall generate a list of all scenarios that share the same attribute or sets of attributes
The system shall provide the ability to specify requirements.
The system shall provide the ability to add a requirement.
The system shall provide the ability to delete a requirement.
The system shall provide the ability to edit a requirement.
The system shall provide a template for specifying requirements.
The system shall provide a demo version of the tool
The system shall allow analysts to add new objects (names, types and other attributes).
The system shall support association of privacy preferences with objects.
The system shall support hierarchical structure of dataand its type.
The system shall allow graphical view of data structures.
The system shall support deriving access control elements.
The system shall allow analysts to view scenario elements and edit access control rules at the same time.
The system shall support a hierarchical representation of organizational structures.
The system shall support the representation of organizational boundaries.
The system shall support the representation of actor relationships.
The system shall support the definition of roles.
The system shall support role delegation.
The system shall support analysis of a specific type of data flow within or across the boundary of an organization, given a set of access control policies.
The system shall support access control specification using Ponder language.
The system shall provide partial support for translating Ponder policy into Alloy specifications for security verification.
The system shall provide a way to extract goals data-usage information from a P3P privacy policy according to the P3P standard.
The system shall provide a way to extract goalsdata-usage information according toas per the user’s privacy preferences in accordance with the P3P standard.
The system shall provide a way to capture the mined goalsinformation from the P3P policy into a database corresponding to a P3P privacy policy.
The system shall provide a way to capture the mined goalsinformation from the user’s privacy preferences into a database corresponding to the user’s privacy preferences.
The system shall provide a way to evaluate the information extracted from the P3P privacy policy against the information extracted from the user’s privacy preferences.
The system shall generate an access log for every add, delete and edit action in the system.
The system shall store all user passwords using a strong, salted cryptographic hash function (e.g., Argon2 or bcrypt).
The system shall enforce TLS 1.2 or higher for all login traffic and implement multi-factor authentication for administrative accounts.
The system shall identify and flag conflicts between privacy policies and access control rules, requiring manual review by an authorized administrator before resolution.
The system shall store passwords using a salted, one-way cryptographic hash function (e.g., Argon2 or PBKDF2) and enforce TLS 1.2+ for all login traffic.
The system shall identify conflicts by flagging logical contradictions between policy goals and scenario goals, and provide a workflow for users to mark conflicts as 'resolved' or 'deferred'.
The system shall authenticate users within 2 seconds under a load of 50 concurrent users.
The system shall complete the automatic comparison of analysis results for up to 10 analysts within 5 seconds of the request.
The system shall propagate goal changes across all associated policies within 3 seconds of the deletion or replacement action.

OPEN: The access log requirement lacks retention policies and protection against tampering. - The system shall store access logs in a read-only format for a minimum of 12 months and ensure logs are protected from unauthorized modification or deletion.

OPEN: The system lacks defined backup, recovery, or data durability requirements for the repository. - The system shall perform automated daily backups of the repository database and provide a recovery time objective (RTO) of 4 hours and a recovery point objective (RPO) of 24 hours.

OPEN: The PRD does not define expected concurrent user load or repository size, which is critical for database performance and multi-user conflict resolution. - The system shall support at least 20 concurrent active users and a repository size of up to 5,000 goals/scenarios without exceeding a 2-second response time for search queries.

OPEN: The system lacks defined capacity limits for the number of concurrent users, policies, goals, or scenarios it must support. - The system shall support a repository of at least 1,000 privacy policies and 10,000 goals while maintaining sub-second response times for search queries.
